searches.query: latest research papers AI ML simplified
searches.answer: The latest research papers in AI and ML include "SimCLR" from February 2020, which simplifies contrastive learning, and "Idefics2" from April 2024, which improves OCR capabilities. "Phi 3 Vision" from May 2024 is the first multimodal model in the Phi family, capable of reasoning over images and text. "GPT-4.5" from February 2025 represents an advancement in scaling unsupervised learning. Other notable papers include "DPO" which simplifies the finetuning process, "QLoRA" for efficient finetuning of quantized large language models, and "Rethinking Langevin Thompson Sampling" from Morgan Stanley. The Transformer model, introduced in a key paper, has become the backbone of many modern NLP systems.
